subject: Best way to achieve internationised UI

messages.author: b54054e5796fe6b4
messages.subject: Best way to achieve internationised UI
parts:
Hi - Given  a shiny app that is being used in the UK (English users) we  need to prepare other language versions ( eg German French etc)

So language of, UI labels , chart titles etc need to be user switchable. 

I am wondering if best approach is to swap UI outputs ggplot titles etc via reactive values changes or if there is a more elegant approach?

Ideas , suggestions appreciated !
